prose_body:
**Finding**: larch-log-flush.sh silences failures silently.
**Reason not implemented**: Accepted and fixed inline — warning now emitted to stderr.

**Finding**: Capture-session-transcript runs before teardown; teardown mutates manifest but no longer commits it.
**Reason not implemented**: Intentional design per issue — "Accept post-merge log loss. No teardown flush." The session-transcript capture Step 18 is the terminal commit point.

**Finding**: ci-merge pre-merge flush removed; rare unpushed log commits could desync merge-pr headRefOid.
**Reason not implemented**: With the new design, log commits piggyback on business commits which are pushed normally. No unpushed log-only commits remain at merge time.

**Finding**: Postmerge manifest no longer committed by ship-pr postmerge or teardown.
**Reason not implemented**: Intentional design per issue — post-merge log loss is accepted. Session-transcript capture in Step 18 is the terminal commit.

**Finding**: --no-logs-commit not honored for commit primitives before ship-pr.sh.
**Reason not implemented**: Documented limitation in SKILL.md. Pre-ship-pr.sh calls (git-commit.sh Steps 4/7, step2-implement.sh Step 2) cannot receive LARCH_NO_LOGS_COMMIT across Bash tool boundaries. The flag remains effective for ship-phase primitives (apply-bump, git-amend-add).

**Finding**: Postmerge manifest finalization no longer committed — session failure before Step 18 loses status=done/pr_number.
**Reason not implemented**: Intentional design per issue — accepted post-merge log loss.
